title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: In the BIG N, a middle school football conference, each team plays every other team exactly once. If a total of \(21\) conference games were played during the \(2012\) season, how many teams were members of the BIG N conference?

solutions.text:
Each of the \(N\) teams plays \(N-1\) games. However, \(2\) teams play each game, so multiplying \(N\) and \(N-1\) would be twice the number of games. Therefore, we know \(N(N-1) = 42.\) This leads to \[N^2 -N +0.25 = 42.25\] which implies \[(N-0.5)^2 = 6.5^2. \] In turn, this suggests: \[N-0.5 = 6.5\]\[ N = 7\]

Thus, the answer is B .
hints: List how many games are added when each new team joins.
With \(n\) teams, the number of games is \(\frac{n(n-1)}{2}\).
